purpose: Read-only manifest for canonical BDM Solo and TMP Solo HJualSM/DJualSM documents whose source status is exactly PD. This file is a review contract only and is never an authorization to import or post transactions.

frozen_stage_scope.purpose: Accept only the final, jointly attested BDM/TMP August 2026 sales freeze. The stage run window, maintenance-window identity, consistency mode, isolation, and the canonical header/detail selection pair are all part of this review contract.

money_reconciliation.review_rule: Discount percentage components are sequential/compound, never interpreted by merely adding the percentages. This report preserves raw components and reconciles source totals within Rp0.05; it does not recalculate or post target financial values.

must_hold_when: source master or UOM conversion map is absent, changed, or ambiguous
header/detail source identity, date, quantity, or total does not reconcile exactly within the reviewed tolerance
source return/payment is nonzero, or an explicit lifecycle signal (UserPK, UserReal, StTranfer, UserBatal, KetBatal) is present; default TglReal/TglBatal timestamps alone are audit-only
the target does not support a numberless faktur draft
a generated sales-order number or source-qualified identity is already occupied
apply_preconditions: A separate approved PD import policy and importer are required.
Opening stock/HPP and AR/plafon strategy must remain explicitly reconciled before operational cutover.
The report plan SHA and frozen stage fingerprints must be rebuilt and re-approved in a serializable apply transaction.
